intro.title: Demonstration scenario for this section
intro.subtitle: What the real estate analysis will look like
intro.description: This section will automatically identify real estate objects in deal documents, cross-reference them with registry and internal sources, and then build a workspace for legal analysis of rights, encumbrances, and registry status.

detection.title: Object Detection
detection.description: The system extracts addresses, cadastral numbers, areas, and object descriptions from deal documents.

verification.title: Registry Verification
verification.description: Detected objects are matched against external registry sources and the internal asset register.

legal.title: Legal Check
legal.description: The interface shows ownership status, encumbrances, title issues, and document references for each object.

re-1.shortDescription: Office building identified in the main deal document package; pledge indicators present, cross-check with registry records required.
re-1.geoNote: Prestigious business location within the Third Transport Ring.
encumbranceNotes: Pledge in favor of Sberbank PJSC under 2022 mortgage agreement.
No registered easements or court arrests found.
legalNotes: Ownership registered in 2018, chain of title without gaps.
Permitted use matches actual office operation.

re-2.shortDescription: Logistics complex with warehouse facilities; no registered encumbrances found.
re-2.geoNote: Transport and logistics zone near Sheremetyevo Airport.
encumbranceNotes: No active encumbrances or restrictions registered.
legalNotes: Land plot leased from municipality until 2045.

re-3.shortDescription: Land plot for commercial development; leasehold pledge and servitude indicators present.
re-3.geoNote: Developing commercial zone near Pulkovo Airport.
encumbranceNotes: Leasehold rights pledged to VTB Bank.

re-4.shortDescription: Industrial premises inside production complex; no encumbrances.
